note: The activity catalog: one source of truth for both halves of the app. The coordinator reads this file directly; Unity reads a generated copy under Resources. Adding an activity is an entry here, not a code change.

activities.tagline: Gentle raises. Personal progress.

help.title: Today we will practice shoulder raises.

steps.copy: Sit comfortably with the AirPod secured to your handle. Rest your arm and start the session.
Reach the glowing target. Hold gently.
Repeat at your pace. Finish set stops early. This guide does not pause your set.

card.caption: Make a little time for yourself.

activities.tagline: Fresh air. Friendly competition.

help.title: Today we will practice golf.

steps.copy: Camera and AirPods connect automatically. Keep both hands in view.
Rest the club at the mat. Wait for Ready.
Aim with the arrows. Swing. Then your friend takes a turn.

card.caption: Take a swing with a friend.

activities.tagline: Line up. Swing. Watch them fall.

help.title: Today we will practice bowling.

steps.copy: Secure your AirPod to your wrist or hand. It connects automatically.
Face the lane and hold still until Ready appears.
Swing gently to roll. Press Pause to rest or return to the menu.

card.caption: Aim down the lane. Swing gently to roll.

activities.tagline: What changed in your program, and why.

help.title: Your therapist will walk you through your program.

steps.copy: Alex talks you through what changed. Each update is written on the whiteboard as it comes up.
Press Next to move on, or Hear it again to go over everything once more.
Anything unclear? Your therapist sees your sessions and can answer at your next appointment.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the handle. Elbow straight.

card.caption: Hold the handle with the AirPod secured to it.

activities.wear: Hold the handle with the AirPod secured to it.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated shoulder raise.

steps.copy: Hold the handle with the AirPod secured to it. Elbow straight. Hold still until Ready.
Sit tall, straight arm, lift the handle and pause at the top. Stop at the line.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the handle. Upper arm still at the side.

card.caption: Hold the handle with the AirPod secured to it.

activities.wear: Hold the handle with the AirPod secured to it.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated biceps curl.

steps.copy: Hold the handle with the AirPod secured to it. Upper arm still at the side. Hold still until Ready.
Elbow stays by your side; curl up slowly and lower with control.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPods in your ears. Sit tall; only the head moves.

card.caption: Put both AirPods in your ears.

activities.wear: Put both AirPods in your ears.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated neck flexion.

steps.copy: Put both AirPods in your ears. Sit tall; only the head moves. Hold still until Ready.
Sit tall and slowly bring your chin toward your chest. Pause, then return to looking ahead.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPods in your ears. Sit tall; only the head moves.

card.caption: Put both AirPods in your ears.

activities.wear: Put both AirPods in your ears.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated neck extension.

steps.copy: Put both AirPods in your ears. Sit tall; only the head moves. Hold still until Ready.
Sit tall and slowly look up toward the ceiling. Pause, then return to looking ahead.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPods in your ears. Shoulders level and relaxed.

card.caption: Put both AirPods in your ears.

activities.wear: Put both AirPods in your ears.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated neck side bend.

steps.copy: Put both AirPods in your ears. Shoulders level and relaxed. Hold still until Ready.
Keep your shoulders down and tip your ear toward your shoulder. Pause, then come back to centre.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the wrist. Elbow straight, arm out to the side.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated side arm raise.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist. Elbow straight, arm out to the side. Hold still until Ready.
Straight arm, lift it out to the side, thumb up. Pause at the line and lower slowly.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the wrist. Elbow straight, arm halfway between forward and the side.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated scaption raise.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist. Elbow straight, arm halfway between forward and the side. Hold still until Ready.
Straight arm, thumb up, lift on a diagonal between forward and the side. Pause at the line.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the wrist. Elbow straight.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated raise and hold.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist. Elbow straight. Hold still until Ready.
Raise your straight arm to the line and hold it there, steady, until the timer finishes.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the wrist. Elbow at your side, bent 90 degrees, forearm level.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated forearm turn.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist. Elbow at your side, bent 90 degrees, forearm level. Hold still until Ready.
Elbow at your side, thumb up. Turn your palm up or down, pause, and return to thumb up.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the wrist. Upper arm out at shoulder height, elbow bent 90 degrees.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist.

help.title: Today we will practice: shoulder rotation at 90/90.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the back of this wrist. Upper arm out at shoulder height, elbow bent 90 degrees. Hold still until Ready.
Arm out at shoulder height, elbow bent, hand forward. Rotate your hand up toward the ceiling, pause, and lower.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the chest. Feet flat, knees still.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated forward bend.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone. Feet flat, knees still. Hold still until Ready.
Sit tall, then bend forward slowly as if reaching for your toes. Pause and sit back up.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the chest. Both hips on the seat; lean, do not reach.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated side bend.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone. Both hips on the seat; lean, do not reach. Hold still until Ready.
Sit tall and lean to the side, keeping both hips on the seat. Pause and come back to centre.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the chest. Hands on your hips, knees straight.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone.

help.title: Today we will practice: standing back bend.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod flat on your breastbone. Hands on your hips, knees straight. Hold still until Ready.
Hands on your hips, gently lean back. Pause and return to standing tall.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the ankle. Thigh stays on the seat.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the front of this shin, just above the ankle.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the front of this shin, just above the ankle.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated knee straightening.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the front of this shin, just above the ankle. Thigh stays on the seat. Hold still until Ready.
Sit back, thigh on the seat. Straighten your knee to lift your foot, pause, and lower slowly.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the ankle. Lying on your back, knee straight.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the front of this shin, just above the ankle.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the front of this shin, just above the ankle.

help.title: Today we will practice: straight-leg raise.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the front of this shin, just above the ankle. Lying on your back, knee straight. Hold still until Ready.
Lying on your back, keep the knee straight and lift the leg to the line. Pause and lower slowly.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the thigh. Standing tall, holding a support; trunk upright.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the front of this thigh, just above the knee.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the front of this thigh, just above the knee.

help.title: Today we will practice: standing side leg raise.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the front of this thigh, just above the knee. Standing tall, holding a support; trunk upright. Hold still until Ready.
Hold a chair, stand tall, and lift your leg out to the side. Pause and lower slowly.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.

activities.tagline: AirPod on the thigh. Sitting tall; lift the knee, not the trunk.

card.caption: Strap the AirPod to the front of this thigh, just above the knee.

activities.wear: Strap the AirPod to the front of this thigh, just above the knee.

help.title: Today we will practice: seated march.

steps.copy: Strap the AirPod to the front of this thigh, just above the knee. Sitting tall; lift the knee, not the trunk. Hold still until Ready.
Sit tall and lift this knee up and down, as if marching. Steady rhythm.
Return to rest between reps. Finish set stops early.
